originalInteractionDecisions.queryControl: A separate nested Country query input never occupies the serialized State or Country fields.
originalInteractionDecisions.pendingSave: Ctrl+A or Accept while nested Country is open requires explicit selection or Back and performs no write.
originalInteractionDecisions.otherCountrySelection: Explicit genuine compact Country selection blanks Region and returns its available suggestions; this bounded original behavior extends observed current-UK acceptance. Unknown Country text remains available only through the direct field, never a synthetic picker choice.
originalInteractionDecisions.keyboardActions: Change Country and Back are command buttons outside the genuine option list. Alt+Down focuses list actions, then Enter activates; Shift+Tab from nested search returns Region. These original web conventions keep ordinary option arrows clamped and do not claim native action traversal parity.
originalInteractionDecisions.directCountry: Direct Country free text remains available and updates Region label/catalog without rewriting country, calling code, raw mobile, currency or dates.
originalInteractionDecisions.address: Reuse existing multiline Address entry and Pincode focus flow; no new mailing database fields.
